description: Public Service Commission - Notify the delegation of powers by the Public Service Commission, w.e.f. 01.06.2017 amending Gaz. Ex. No. 2014/3 of 11.04.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification involves the Public Service Commission delegating powers related to disciplinary control, appointments, promotions, transfers, and examination concessions for education sector officers. It specifically deals with public service administration, recruitment procedures, and service conditions, which aligns with the definition of Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) covering public service recruitment, service conditions, and administrative instructions.
